items.t: Benioff Says “226K Custom Agents” Now Run on Slack. Salesforce Has a New Answer to the SaaSpocalypse

With Slack hosting agents and Microsoft bringing Salesforce’s data into Copilot and Teams, Salesforce is plugging into the AI tools investors feared would replace it.
